title: Multiparametric senescence profiling by spectral flow cytometry uncovers endothelial heterogeneity following irradiation
task: Characterize radiation-induced senescence heterogeneity in endothelial cells using multiparametric flow cytometry
key_results: Dose-dependent senescence response observed across 0-20 Gy x-ray exposure; higher energy (18 MV) showed more deleterious effects than lower energy (10 MV) at same dose rate (2.5 Gy/min)
comments: The use of 14-color spectral flow cytometry with UMAP dimensionality reduction is robust for capturing cellular heterogeneity, though validation against established senescence markers (p16/p21) would strengthen claims.

outputs: UMAP clustering revealing senescence-associated marker signatures

hypotheses.hypothesis: Radiation induces dose-dependent senescence in endothelial cells
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; dose-dependent response observed across both 10 and 18 MV energies

hypotheses.hypothesis: Higher energy x-rays produce more severe senescence phenotypes than lower energy at equivalent dose rates
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 18 MV showed stronger senescence marker elevation and deleterious effects versus 10 MV

title: Hydrogen gas alleviates osteoarthritis by inhibiting oxidative stress, apoptosis, inflammation, and extracellular matrix catabolism via the Nrf2/HO-1/NOX4 signaling pathway
task: Determine whether hydrogen gas suppresses ROS-mediated osteoarthritis progression via Nrf2/HO-1/NOX4 pathway activation
key_results: In vivo: H₂ reduced OARSI scores, decreased TUNEL+ cells, downregulated MMP-1/13; In vitro: H₂ reduced ROS/8-OHdG/HNE, downregulated cleaved caspase-3/Bax, upregulated Bcl-2, inhibited iNOS/COX-2/IL-6, and promoted Nrf2/HO-1 while suppressing NOX4; Nrf2 knockdown eliminated H₂ protection
comments: Mechanistic elegance is strong with Nrf2 knockdown confirming causality, though NF-κB inhibition appears Nrf2-dependent without direct interaction evidence.

model_io.model: Rat OA model (anterior cruciate ligament transection + medial meniscus resection)

hypotheses.hypothesis: H₂ activates Nrf2/HO-1/NOX4 pathway to suppress ROS, apoptosis, inflammation, and ECM catabolism in OA
hypotheses.result: Strongly supported; Nrf2 knockdown abolished H₂ protection; H₂ promoted Nrf2 nuclear translocation and inhibited NF-κB in Nrf2-dependent manner

title: Danshensu attenuates type 2 diabetes-related osteoporosis via the PI3K/AKT/Nrf2 signaling pathway
task: Evaluate danshensu effects on type 2 diabetes-related osteoporosis via PI3K/AKT/Nrf2 antioxidant signaling
key_results: DSS improved trabecular microarchitecture and reduced bone loss in T2DOP mice; in high-glucose BMSCs, DSS reduced ROS/MDA, enhanced SOD/CAT activity, increased ALP activity and mineralized nodule formation; PI3K/AKT/Nrf2 blockade attenuated DSS effects
comments: Pharmacological blockade confirms pathway involvement but does not establish whether PI3K/AKT directly phosphorylates Nrf2 or acts through intermediate mechanisms.

model_io.model: High-glucose-exposed bone marrow stromal cell (BMSC) differentiation

hypotheses.hypothesis: DSS counters T2DOP through PI3K/AKT/Nrf2-dependent antioxidant responses and osteogenic differentiation
hypotheses.result: Supported; blocking PI3K or Nrf2 weakened DSS-induced protective effects

title: Aerobic exercise induces selective changes in skeletal muscle protein quality control markers in rats with heart failure
task: Evaluate autophagy-lysosomal preservation and oxidative stress mitigation in skeletal muscle during heart failure progression with aerobic exercise
key_results: Exercise reduced protein carbonyls (p=0.0043) and p62 expression (p=0.0449); HF induced type II fiber atrophy and impaired all five oxidative phosphorylation complexes (p<0.05)
comments: Autophagic flux was not directly assessed despite elevated LC3B-II/I ratios, limiting mechanistic conclusions about flux restoration.

model_io.model: Rat heart failure model with aerobic exercise intervention

hypotheses.hypothesis: Aerobic exercise preserves autophagy-lysosomal function and reduces oxidative stress in HF skeletal muscle
hypotheses.result: Partially supported; exercise reduced protein carbonyls and p62, but autophagic flux not confirmed

title: Allogeneic adipose-derived mesenchymal stem cells on a decellularized lung scaffold accelerate healing of experimental burn injury in rabbits
task: Evaluate accelerated burn wound healing with allogeneic adipose-derived mesenchymal stem cells delivered on decellularized lung scaffolds
key_results: By day 17, ASCs-DRLS wounds were significantly smaller than control (0.20±0.01 vs 0.61±0.04 cm², p=0.0002); on day 14, ASCs-DRLS showed greater re-epithelialization (3.17±0.33 vs 1.33±0.33, p=0.007) and inflammation resolution (2.83±0.33 vs 1.50±0.00, p=0.023); enhanced collagen deposition on day 28 (3.83±0.16 vs 2.17±0.33, p=0.006); DRLS alone showed no significant benefit
comments: Scaffold contribution appears passive, with therapeutic effect primarily attributable to ASC paracrine activity, though specific paracrine factors were not identified.

model_io.model: Rabbit full-thickness burn wound model with three treatment groups
outputs: Histopathological scores (re-epithelialization, inflammation resolution, collagen deposition)

hypotheses.hypothesis: ASCs delivered on DRLS accelerate burn wound healing through enhanced paracrine activity in a supportive microenvironment
hypotheses.result: Supported; ASCs-DRLS significantly outperformed both control and DRLS-alone groups; DRLS alone provided no benefit

title: Effects of Yijing decoction on diminished ovarian reserve: associations with mitochondrial function, apoptosis, and the PGC-1α/SIRT3/HIF-1α pathway
task: Determine mechanisms by which Yijing decoction protects granulosa cells and restores ovarian reserve in diminished ovarian reserve
key_results: YJD restored estrous cycle regularity, elevated AMH and E2 while reducing FSH/LH (all p<0.05); upregulated PGC-1α/SIRT3 and downregulated HIF-1α in granulosa cells; reduced apoptosis and ROS accumulation
comments: Network pharmacology identified 319 intersecting targets, but causal role of PGC-1α/SIRT3/HIF-1α pathway requires further functional validation.

model_io.model: Isolated granulosa cell culture with high glucose exposure

hypotheses.hypothesis: YJD protects granulosa cells via PGC-1α/SIRT3/HIF-1α pathway-mediated mitochondrial homeostasis and apoptosis suppression
hypotheses.result: Supported; YJD upregulated PGC-1α/SIRT3, downregulated HIF-1α, and reduced apoptosis/ROS

title: Nonlinear joint modeling of oxygenation indices for dynamic mortality prediction in neonates with persistent pulmonary hypertension receiving inhaled nitric oxide
task: Dynamic mortality prediction in neonatal PPHN using nonlinear joint modeling
key_results: Nonlinear OSI-based joint model achieved validation AUC of 0.84, substantially outperforming linear models (0.78–0.82), OI-based models (0.75–0.83), and nSOFA-based models (0.68–0.70); 24-h AUC = 0.93
comments: The framework leverages serial longitudinal oxygenation data to capture rapid physiological changes, a principled improvement over static clinical indices, though external validation across different PPHN populations remains important.

outputs: model discrimination metrics (AUC, DIC, WAIC, LPML)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Dynamic oxygenation trajectories are independent predictors of mortality in PPHN neonates receiving iNO
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; non-survivors showed persistently higher OSI and OI trajectories (p < 0.001)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Nonlinear joint modeling outperforms linear approaches and static severity scores for mortality prediction
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; nonlinear OSI model achieved superior discrimination (validation AUC 0.84 vs. 0.78–0.70 for competing models)

title: Neuro-fault recognition-based cybersecurity framework for cardio-hydro-electromechanical stimulators
task: Cyber-attack detection and mitigation in biomedical stimulators via neuro-fault recognition and safe reinforcement learning
key_results: Safety-enhanced Ni-MPC improves control performance 27.4% vs. RL-based MPC and 49.8% vs. unprotected PI controller under measurement tampering
comments: Novel application of safe-DRL for constrained medical device control under cyber-threats, though evaluation is simulation-based without real device validation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Neuro-fault recognition identifies measurement tampering by state-output discrepancy
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: attack identification enables safe-DRL mitigation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Safe-DRL with bounded policies prevents constraint violations while rejecting cyber-attacks
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: superior cardiac tracking and attack rejection vs. baselines in simulation

title: Multi-objective sustainable DER allocation in active distribution networks based on Slime Mould Algorithm
task: Multi-objective DER placement and sizing in active distribution networks via Slime Mould Algorithm
key_results: SMA reduces active power loss 71.0% (202.67→58.73 kW), reactive loss 68.3%, improves minimum voltage 0.9131→0.988 p.u., increases voltage stability index 0.6678→0.9548, cuts carbon emissions 42.1% (1.46M→0.84M kg CO₂/yr), achieves 92.35% renewable penetration; outperforms PSO, DE, GA, WOA
comments: Comprehensive multi-objective optimization with strong performance metrics, though evaluation limited to single IEEE 33-bus test system; scalability to larger networks not demonstrated.

model_io.model: Slime Mould Algorithm (SMA) with backward-forward sweep load-flow

hypotheses.hypothesis: SMA-based multi-objective framework achieves superior convergence and robustness vs. PSO, DE, GA, WOA
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: SMA demonstrates fastest convergence, computational efficiency, and best multi-objective trade-offs

title: Robust UAV target detection under synthetic severe weather degradations with adaptive feature propagation
task: UAV object detection under severe weather degradation
key_results: SW-DEIM achieves AP50 68.1% and AP50:95 50.0% on synthetic Drone-SW (7.9 and 6.5 pp improvement over DEIM); AP50 55.8% on real foggy HazyDet subset; maintains 188.2 FPS
comments: Strong synthetic weather results, but acknowledged lack of independent evaluation on naturally captured rain/snow limits claims of real-world robustness across all weather types.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Severe Weather Vision Mamba (SWVIM) with adaptive feature propagation improves detection under adverse weather
hypotheses.result: Confirmed on synthetic and foggy real data; transfer to real fog demonstrated but other weather types not validated

title: RCMS: a robust cybersecurity metamodel for cloud computing in Saudi Arabia
task: Develop localized cybersecurity metamodel for cloud computing in Saudi Arabia
key_results: RCMS defines 17 security concepts mapped to NCA ECC-1:2018 and SAMA frameworks; instantiated for banking, healthcare, and energy sectors
comments: This is primarily a conceptual/architectural contribution without empirical deployment validation; the instantiations are author-constructed illustrations rather than measured implementations.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Metamodel incorporating Vision 2030, NCA, and SAMA constraints improves cloud security tailoring for Saudi Arabia
hypotheses.result: Framework designed but not independently validated; scalability and reusability remain design intentions

title: Digital literacy shapes AI chatbot adoption, barriers, and performance outcomes in football coaches: a multi-method analytical study
task: Identify digital literacy as mediator of AI chatbot adoption among football coaches
key_results: Digital literacy fully mediated age effect on adoption (indirect effect ab = −0.31); critical competency threshold 4.5/7 separates 28% adoption (below) from 78% (above); 'AI Value Chain' cluster (10%) reports 8.9/10 satisfaction and 3+ hrs/week time savings
comments: Well-designed mediation analysis and threshold identification, though single-domain sample (football coaches) limits broader organizational technology adoption insights.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Digital literacy mediates negative age effect on adoption
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: complete mediation (ab = −0.31)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Critical digital competency threshold exists for adoption probability shift
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: threshold 4.5/7 separates 28%–78% adoption rates (χ²(1) = 48.7, p < 0.001)

title: Troll detection using generative adversarial network (GAN) based on social network features
task: Troll detection via GAN-based semi-supervised learning
key_results: TrollGAN achieves higher accuracy and F1-score than LSTM and logistic regression baselines on Twitter datasets (14,940 small-scale and ~3M Russian tweets); maintains stable performance under increased data scale
comments: The shared LSTM channel between generator and classifier is conceptually interesting, but evaluation on only two Twitter datasets limits generalization claims across diverse troll ecosystems.

hypotheses.hypothesis: GAN adversarial framework with social features improves troll detection robustness
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: TrollGAN outperforms LSTM and logistic regression baselines

title: Inert gas atmospheric pressure plasma post-processing of fused silica micro-lenses produced by means of femtosecond laser-induced chemical etching
task: Post-processing fused silica micro-lenses via atmospheric pressure plasma polishing
key_results: Surface roughness reduced from Ra 0.207 ± 0.044 µm to 0.047 ± 0.018 µm (>75% reduction)
Optimal parameters: 5 mm discharge gap, 5.5 W plasma power
comments: Effective smoothing technique that maintains lens geometry, though plasma instability at higher powers limits throughput scaling.

model_io.model: Femtosecond laser-induced chemical etching (FLICE) + inert gas atmospheric pressure plasma polishing

hypotheses.hypothesis: Stable plasma discharge with high electric field strength maximizes polishing efficiency
hypotheses.result: Confirmed at 5 mm gap and 5.5 W; higher power/distance caused instability and reduced efficiency

hypotheses.hypothesis: Plasma polishing preserves engineered lens geometry
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via microscopic and interferometric characterization

title: Design of a novel filtering antenna using waveguide with enhanced stopband attenuation
task: Design of compact waveguide filtering antenna with enhanced stopband attenuation
key_results: Inline filtenna: 1.02 GHz filtering bandwidth, 7.05 dBi gain, <-19 dB reflection coefficient over 10.6–11.25 GHz
Rotated-offset filtenna: 0.5 GHz radiation bandwidth at 9–9.5 GHz, 6.15 dBi gain, >90% overall efficiency
comments: Novel two-post design elegantly integrates filtering and radiation in single compact component, though trade-offs between filtering and radiation bandwidth remain device-dependent.

model_io.model: Rectangular waveguide (WR-90) with two metallic posts in inline and rotated-offset configurations
outputs: transmission zeros, quality factor, stopband attenuation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Two-post design enables accurate control of transmission zeros without coupling irises
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; inline and rotated-offset configurations achieve tunable filtering bandwidth and high stopband rejection

hypotheses.hypothesis: Rotated-offset orientation improves wideband impedance matching compared to inline
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; rotated-offset shows impedance match 8.92–9.5 GHz vs. inline narrow band
